enabled.description: Whether the fapolicyd service is enabled to start at boot.

log_file.description: Path to the log file, or 'syslog' to use system logging.

trust_network.description: If true, fapolicyd logs access decisions immediately (real-time logging). If false, decisions are buffered (better performance).

network_trust.description: If true, trust network-based policy sources (e.g., NIS, LDAP). Enable only on secure networks.

event_buffer_size.description: Maximum number of events to buffer before dropping new events during high load.

rules_dir.description: Directory containing `.rules` files that define access policies.

trust_paths.description: List of paths considered trusted — files under these paths bypass logging and are implicitly allowed.

items.description: Absolute path or glob pattern to a trusted directory (e.g., '/usr/bin').

integrity_check.description: If true, compute checksums on file access (ensures file integrity). May impact performance.

metadata_cache_ttl.description: Time in seconds to cache file metadata before revalidating. 0 disables caching.

security_label.description: If true, integrate with AppArmor/SELinux security labels for labeling-based policies.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used to track the daemon process.

workers.description: Number of worker threads for policy evaluation. 0 = auto-detect (CPU count).

rule_cache.description: If true, cache compiled policy rules for faster daemon startup.

rule_cache_file.description: Path to the compiled policy cache file.
